Peer-reviewed journal articles I have contributed to as part of the
biostatistics and programming team at GRAIL. My contribution to these studies
was in statistical analysis and programming, and I am credited in the
acknowledgments of each.

```{r publications, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
pubs <- list(
  list(
    authors = paste(
      "Sasieni P, Neal RD, Swanton C, et al.",
      "(NHS-Galleri Trial Investigators)"
    ),
    year = "2026",
    title = paste(
      "Effect of a Multicancer Early-Detection Test on Late-Stage Cancer",
      "Diagnosis"
    ),
    journal = "New England Journal of Medicine",
    doi = "10.1056/NEJMoa2505723",
    note = "NHS-Galleri clinical utility trial."
  ),
  list(
    authors = "Neal RD, et al. (NHS-Galleri Trial Investigators)",
    year = "2026",
    title = paste(
      "Performance of a multi-cancer early detection test in the randomized",
      "controlled NHS-Galleri trial"
    ),
    journal = "Nature Medicine",
    doi = "10.1038/s41591-026-04652-8",
    note = "NHS-Galleri test performance. Open access (CC BY)."
  ),
  list(
    authors = "Nabavizadeh N, McDonnell C, Kurbegov D, et al.",
    year = "2026",
    title = paste(
      "Performance and safety of a multi-cancer early detection test: the",
      "PATHFINDER 2 study"
    ),
    journal = "Nature Medicine",
    doi = "10.1038/s41591-026-04618-w",
    note = "PATHFINDER 2 study. Open access (CC BY)."
  )
)

html <- '<div class="project-grid">'
for (p in pubs) {
  citation <- sprintf(
    "%s (%s). %s. <em>%s</em>.",
    p$authors, p$year, p$title, p$journal
  )
  html <- paste0(html, sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<a class="project-card" href="https://doi.org/%s" ',
      'rel="noopener noreferrer"><div class="card-icon">&#128218;</div>',
      "<h3>%s</h3><p>%s</p>",
      '<p style="margin-top:0.6em;">%s</p>',
      '<p style="margin-top:0.6em;color:var(--link-color);">',
      "doi.org/%s</p></a>"
    ),
    p$doi, p$title, citation, p$note, p$doi
  ))
}
html <- paste0(html, "</div>")
cat(html)
```

<p style="font-size:0.85em;color:var(--muted-text);margin-top:1.5em;">
The two <em>Nature Medicine</em> articles are open access under a CC BY
license. The <em>NEJM</em> article is available via the DOI link above.
</p>
